_comment: Every address below was verified against Base mainnet on 2026-09-21. Do not edit by hand without re-verifying — a wrong address here is a drained plan.
_deployment: null until the vault is on Base mainnet. While it is null the web app builds in PRE-LAUNCH mode: no wallet button, no deposits, and the app pages say they are not open yet. The mainnet deploy fills it with { vault, oracle, yieldAdapter, swapAdapter, keeper, deployBlock, routeIds: { NVDAc: 1, ... }, verified }, and that one change is what opens the site.

AaveV3aUSDC._note: Aave's aUSDC. REBASES: balance is scaledBalanceOf * liquidityIndex, so the vault ledgers the scaled unit. Confirmed live by ForkAdapters.t.sol, which supplies and withdraws real USDC through the pool above.

yieldVault._choice: Gauntlet USDC Prime — largest Base USDC vault, and verified to hold ZERO allocation to B20 stock-collateral markets. Steakhouse High Yield USDC v1.1 pays 5.30% but holds 3.2% in AAPLc/GOOGLc/METAc/NVDAc/SPCXc collateral markets: correlated with exactly the assets this protocol buys, so its extra yield is compensation for the risk we must not take.
